title: Set password
purpose: Add a usable password to an account that does not currently have one.

sections.title: Eligibility
paragraphs: Requires a signed-in account without a usable password. If the account already has one, the page redirects to Change Password. No current password is requested here.

items.label: Password
items.description: Required new password, at least eight characters. It must pass the configured checks for similarity to account details, common passwords and entirely numeric values. The confirmation must match exactly. Errors keep the form open; password fields may need entering again.

items.label: Set Password
items.description: Creates a usable password, preserves this browser’s session and returns to Change Password with a success message. This does not issue roles, set client ownership or create an alternative login method.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: An account without a password still needs an available authorized sign-in or recovery method to reach this screen. Errors do not save a password. Password changes do not remove MFA.
